notes.title: Dev Book DLC Launch!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, it's finally here!

You can get the Locke(d) Dev Book starting today:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3471840/Locked__Dev_Book/

It contains 40+ pages of commentary, concept art, fun facts, and more!

Thank you for all your support over the years, and I hope the dev book gives you some interesting insights into how and why this game was made!

Sadly, it is only available in [b]English[/b] for now, but the PDF can be fully copy-pasted into a translation software, if you like. I hope you enjoy!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/nbNzd8S][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/5d99c9f2ca95e9cded14b9037154c1a78353e33c.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Anniversary & DLC Announcement!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Time really flies — yesterday, Locke(d) celebrated 2 years of being on Steam (and 4 years since being first released in general)!

Within those two years, we almost managed to gather [b]1000 reviews[/b], which is more than I ever could've expected! I read every single one of them, and while I understand that it's a bit of a controversial game, I'm happy to see that most people had a good time with it.

To show my appreciation and also answer some long-standing questions, I finally decided to put together a [b]Development & Art Book[/b]! 

Even better: It's coming out in [b]just 2 weeks[/b]! Please [b]wishlist [/b]it to be announced when it launches:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3471840/Locked__Dev_Book

The Dev Book will also include a small FAQ, so if you have any question about Locke(d) — be it about Host, philosophy, how the game was made, or anything else — feel free to [b]add a comment in the discussion below[/b]. (All languages welcome!)

Thank you so much for your support!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/fdf885ac92d5ceb53eb9e9f00df3a4b34fb7e890.png[/img]
↓ I'm also working on other stuff. Keep in touch with the links below!

notes.title: Japanese Translation!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce Locke(d) is now also available to play in [b]Japanese[/b]! 
Huge thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/place_b09]place_b[/url] for the translation.

notes.title: New Language & Merch!
notes.content:
I have big news!!!

The [b]Host keychain[/b] arrived today, and I'm so happy with how it looks:

[url=https://ko-fi.com/s/51c182b17c][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/b50bf87c08873c93f6472ab9f3839fcc5496fd24.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/s/51c182b17c][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/44bbe4029e6286fdbebf078ea42931770785a172.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Host Keychain!
notes.content:
It's almost been 4 months since Locke(d)'s release on Steam, and I still can't thank you enough for all the positive responses!

Quite a few of you have been requesting a way to save the Host from [spoiler]the game[/spoiler], which is why I'm happy to announce you will soon be able to carry her around with you in [b]physical form[/b]:

[url=https://ko-fi.com/s/51c182b17c][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/1f4a881a3868a502ec8c59190822368c84495286.png[/img][/url]

[h3]That's right — an [b]official Locke(d) Keychain[/b] is coming out! [/h3]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/s/51c182b17c][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/44bbe4029e6286fdbebf078ea42931770785a172.png[/img][/url]

The first sample is currently on its way to me, and I can't wait to show you photos of the finished product! Until then, [b]preorders are already open[/b]!

[i]I can't guarantee if I'll ever order a second batch, so make sure to [b]preorder and don't miss out[/b] on this potential one-time chance.[/i]

Thank you so much for your support, and I look forward to sharing more news with you soon!

notes.title: 500 Reviews and 4 new languages!
notes.content:
It's not even been 3 months, and yet so much has happened! 

So many amazing translators have contributed their work to this project, and I couldn't be more grateful. Since the last update announcement, [b]4 new languages[/b] were added: Spanish, Traditional Chinese, Romanian, and Italian!

I'm really happy (although the Host probably isn't) that this game can be played by so many people around the world.

Today also marks the day that we hit [b]500 Reviews[/b], and reached an [b]"Overwhelmingly Positive"[/b] rating. 
I never would've expected this, especially in such a short amount of time, but I appreciate every single one of you who rated the game and made this possible! 

Thank you, from the bottom of my heart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43445692/fdf885ac92d5ceb53eb9e9f00df3a4b34fb7e890.png[/img]

Aside from that, development on my main project is also going well.

I released an [url=https://ko-fi.com/post/Beta-Access-for-Artificial-Selection-Z8Z7KCHSV]update for the Beta[/url] which added 1-2 new hours of content, and I'm currently adding more camera movements to make the game even more immersive!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389870/Artificial_Selection

notes.title: Polish translation!
notes.content:
Locke(d) is now available in [b]Polish[/b]! 
This update also introduces a very, very minor change to Host's sprite.

In just under a month, the number of translations for Locke(d) has doubled. On top of that, I can't thank you enough for the overwhelmingly positive reviews! 

It really means a lot to me that my small game had such a big impact on some of you. 
Let's aim for [b]500 reviews[/b] to get that official "Overwhelmingly Positive" rating!

On a different note, development on my current project is progressing smoothly!

[b]Artificial Selection[/b] is another mystery visual novel, but with much more gameplay, and the demo expansion I was talking about is finally here! You can play the first 2-3 hours of it right now for FREE:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389870/Artificial_Selection

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Hungarian translation!
notes.content:

On top of that, a [b]Spanish[/b] and a [b]Polish[/b] translation are currently being worked on.

In case you are interested in making Locke(d) available in your native language, I simplified the process as much as possible. You can find all the necessary files and information [b][url=https://ko-fi.com/s/1c91275d2b]here[/url][/b]!

Thank you for your support!
[i]Köszönjük a munkát![/i]

notes.title: Russian translation!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! First of all, I wanted to thank you all for the overwhelming support so far. 

I never expected Locke(d) to be found and enjoyed by so many people. Ironically, the game really was picked up by some kind of algorithm that promoted the game way more than I could've anticipated. The chain of causality works in mysterious ways...

I appreciate all the thoughts you've shared in your reviews (I read every single one!), and encourage you to join my [url=https://discord.com/invite/nbNzd8S]Discord server[/url] if you want to continue the discussion. We'd love to see you there!

Also, check out the game I'm working on right now. There's a big demo update coming out next week that will allow you to play the first 2 hours for free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389870/Artificial_Selection/

With that out of the way, this update brings:
[list]
[*] Russian Translation
[*] Changed the menu font for Turkish and Russian
[*] The [SECRET] can now be activated multiple times
[*] Switched the position of the "Mute" button
[/list]

Thank you!
